```{=html}
<section class="about-section">

    <div class="about-content">
      <div class="about-text">
        <p>
          AffineDrift is curated by Dieter Olson, a chemical engineer who spends his days managing R&amp;D programs around plasma arc gasification. The nights and early mornings are devoted to golf biomechanics, nonlinear control, and modeling the swing as a coupled multibody system.
        </p>
        <p>
          Years of collecting instructional literature led to a simple question: how much of the swing is explained by history already stored in the state, and how much by deliberate control? The answer required a mathematical framework, so the site grew into a living notebook of derivations, counterfactual analyses, and validation experiments.
        </p>
        <p>
          Every article is written with reproducibility in mind. Equations are rendered with MathJax, toolchains are documented, and conversions from LaTeX to Quarto are tracked in git. If you want to extend the work, grab a branch, add a new <code>.qmd</code>, and contribute.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

```
